I found three Vantorre Group tickets across the pod channel, the Hartford war room and Moss's Strategic digests. I posted the list in the #strategic-pod thread with a source for each.

- **#8841 (also written #PD-8841):** It appears in four sources, and they conflict.
  - The 4/27 digest has it as two missed carrier check-ins at Allentown.
  - The 5/4 digest has it open as a gate kiosk timeout at Allentown.
  - Gideon said in #strategic-pod on 7/1 that he had closed it.
  - The 9/30 digest shows it as newly submitted for a Newark kiosk problem.

  I flagged that its current status needs checking in the support system before it goes to Mateo.
- **INC-4821:** Hartford kiosk outage, from #inc-vtg-hartford on 8/3.
- **VT-55120:** Root-cause ticket for the Hartford outage, from #inc-vtg-hartford on 10/14.

I left out #PD-4418. That digest says only "the account Nadia runs", so I can't confirm it belongs to the parent. I also left out #4812, which is Vantorre Mobility, and #PD-4402, which is Quillfeather.

This is not the full ticket history. It covers only those three sources, and I can't see the support system itself.
